headroom_rule: smallest whole minute >= the longest frozen pack input duration, computed from kdenlive_owner_pack_manifest.json byte sizes (48 kHz / 16-bit / mono); result-independent: no GT, marker, comparator, or observed alignment outcome feeds the value
scoring_rule: Score each canonical pair from exactly one saved project: the scoring_run project when this file has a rule for the pair, otherwise the canonical pairNN project. void_runs are preserved as evidence only and are never scored. Automated comparators stay sealed until the ten scoring runs exist.
